Zakat is a separate, obligatory act of w: Zakka ibada ce ta daban, wajibi: nisabi, ƙididdiga da rukunin masu karɓa guda takwas suna sashen “Zakka”. Wannan shafi yana ɗauke da sadaka ta nafila kawai.
